# Skaylon

> Skaylon (Skaylon Technology) is a founder-led software development studio in Kasaragod, Kerala, India. It designs and builds websites, web applications, iOS and Android apps, custom business software, UI/UX designs and backend/API systems for small and mid-sized businesses and startups in India and abroad. Projects start with a short discovery phase and a written fixed-scope proposal; clients own the code and designs.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Skaylon Technology (registered MSME in India, Udyam registration UDYAM-KL-05-0037475)
- Location: Kasaragod, Kerala, India; works remotely with clients in India and other countries
- Contact: skaylon.in@gmail.com, +91 80759 15386
- Technologies named on the site: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Flutter, Figma
- Typical timelines: business website 4–8 weeks; mobile app 10–16 weeks; others set in the proposal

## Services

- [Websites](https://skaylon.com/services/website-development): business websites, landing pages, CMS setup, redesigns and technical SEO
- [Web Applications](https://skaylon.com/services/web-application-development): customer portals, dashboards, SaaS products and integrations
- [Mobile Apps](https://skaylon.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps from one Flutter codebase, including store release
- [Custom Software](https://skaylon.com/services/custom-software-development): internal business systems, workflow automation, reporting and MVPs
- [UI/UX Design](https://skaylon.com/services/ui-ux-design): user research, flows, prototypes, Figma design systems and developer handoff
- [Backend and API Systems](https://skaylon.com/services/backend-api-development): REST APIs, database design, authentication and third-party integrations
